name: hash.crc64
doc:
hash.crc64: CRC-64 with the ISO or ECMA polynomial (Go's
hash/crc64): crc64.Checksum(data, crc64.MakeTable(crc64.ECMA)).

items.name: MakeTable
items.doc:
The table of polynomial poly (crc64.ISO, crc64.ECMA or another
reversed polynomial).
items.summary: The table of polynomial poly (crc64.ISO, crc64.ECMA or another reversed polynomial).

items.name: New
items.doc: A new streaming CRC-64 with table tab.
items.summary: A new streaming CRC-64 with table tab.

items.name: Update
items.signature: func Update(crc uint, tab Table, p []byte) uint

members.name: Write
members.doc: Write adds p to the checksum; it never fails.
members.summary: Write adds p to the checksum; it never fails.

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the checksum.
members.summary: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the checksum.

members.name: Sum
members.doc: Sum returns the checksum as 8 big-endian bytes.
members.summary: Sum returns the checksum as 8 big-endian bytes.

items.name: Table
items.doc: A precomputed table for one polynomial (reversed form).
items.summary: A precomputed table for one polynomial (reversed form).
